reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki Remove `experimental.ruler.enable-api` in favour of `ruler.enable-api` 10380", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Environments configured with `experimental.ruler.enable-api` will have this setting ignored; the configuration must be migrated to `ruler.enable-api` to take effect.
consequence.remediation: Rename the configuration key from `experimental.ruler.enable-api` to `ruler.enable-api` in your Loki configuration.

proposed.statement: The experimental configuration key `experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed in favour of the standard `ruler.enable-api` key.
